constraints.explanation: the clods, the crumbs and the stones together fit inside the height range

controls.explanation: The earth where it is dry on top.
controls.label: Soil colour

controls.explanation: What the hollows darken to where water sits.
controls.label: Damp colour

controls.explanation: The stones the digging left, chosen per stone.
controls.label: Stone colours

controls.explanation: How many clods of earth fit across one tile; more means finer tilth.
controls.label: Clod size

controls.explanation: How far the clods of earth rise and fall.
controls.label: Clod relief

controls.explanation: How much a clod shows as a change of tone as well as of height.
controls.label: Clod tone

controls.explanation: How many crumbs of earth fit across one tile; this is the grain a person sees up close.
controls.label: Crumb size

controls.explanation: How far a crumb of earth stands above the one beside it.
controls.label: Crumb relief

controls.explanation: How much the crumbs show as a change of tone.
controls.label: Crumb tone

controls.explanation: How many stones fit across one tile at most, one to a cell.
controls.label: Stone spacing

controls.explanation: How much of the bed is stone rather than earth, in percent.
controls.label: Stones

controls.explanation: How far the largest stone stands above the earth around it.
controls.label: Stone relief

controls.explanation: How many drifts of stone fit across one tile; the digging leaves them in drifts.
controls.label: Stone drifts

controls.explanation: How much darker the hollows are than the crests, in percent.
controls.label: Dampness

controls.explanation: How matte the earth is, in thousandths; soil is nearly wholly diffuse.
controls.label: Soil roughness

controls.explanation: How matte a stone is, in thousandths.
controls.label: Stone roughness

controls.explanation: Millimetres between the lowest and highest point the height map can hold.
controls.label: Height range

controls.explanation: How far around each point the surface is compared to find crevices.
controls.label: Occlusion radius

controls.explanation: How far below its surroundings a point must sit to be fully shadowed.
controls.label: Occlusion depth

controls.explanation: The darkest a crevice can get, in thousandths.
controls.label: Occlusion strength
